changelog: - **New gate `estimator_mixin_order`**: flags a scikit-learn mixin (ClassifierMixin, RegressorMixin, ...) listed after `BaseEstimator` in a class statement, which silently makes `is_classifier`/`is_regressor` return False under scikit-learn >= 1.6. Waive with `# mixin-order-ok: <reason>`. Consumers that have such a class turn red; fix by moving the mixin before `BaseEstimator`.
